preview.body: Man obedo neno macon me API pi lucoo lok angeya ki lurem. Pe twero lwongo ne kombedi: backend cwalo i Phase 2, ki agiki, kabedo ki lageng twero loke mapud peya kit ma 1.

overview.title: Neno weng
overview.body: Zuula API miyo ki lucoo lok angeya ma ki yee ki dul mapat-pat ma ribe kwedgi ngec marom ma tiyo i kom zuula.ug. Pimo ne woto kene:
overview.step1: Cwal lok ma i POST /v1/checks. Inongo yoo me lubu ID cutcut.
overview.step3: Kwan kop ma ki ngolo, rwom me gen, kit ma kitye ka tito kwede ki lok ma ki nyutu ki i adwogi ne.
overview.format: JSON iwi HTTPS (UTF-8). Kare me tic tye ISO 8601 i UTC.

auth.title: Ngiyo lok ada
auth.body: Kwayo weng mito API key i Authorization header. Lucoo lok angeya ma ki moko ni gi tye ki twero me tic ki ludito tic twero cako ki juku key i Account → API donyo. Key cakke ki zl_live_ dok kinyuto ne tyen acel keken.

auth.serverOnly: Pe iket API key i web page, mobile app onyo public repository. Goo API ki i kom server ni me juku key mo keken ma twero bedo ni okato woko.

rate.title: Kigeng me wel
rate.body: Lanyut acel acel twero yubu {limit} kwac i cawa acel. Lagam acel acel nyutu kony ma odong. Ka ikato iye, API lagam 429 Too Many Requests: kur pi wel cekon i Retry-After mapwod pe itemo doki.

headers.limit: Kwayo ma ki yee pi cawa acel pi lagony man.
headers.remaining: Kwayo ma ki weko i cawa matye kombedi.
headers.reset: Ka kare me tic ocako, macalo Unix timestamp i cekon.
headers.retryAfter: Cwalo ki 429 lagam: cekon me kuru ma pwod pe itemo odoco.

submit.title: Cwal cente
submit.body: Cwal jami acel pi moko ada. Tii ki JSON pi coc, kubbe ki coc ma kiyubu, ki multipart/form-data pi pwail me media. Lagam oo cutcut ki lubu kor ID; ngiyo ne kikome tero cekon ma romo 10 pi coc ki cok ki dakika acel pi media.

report.body: Dwoko lok ada acel ma kicoyo ki ID: ngec marom ma tye i kom lwak <link>pot buk me adwogi tic</link>, ma kwako ngolo kop, gen, kit ma kicoyo kwede, lok ma kicoyo ki rwom me lwak.

webhooks.body: Kiyubu kacel ki API wek pe i bed ki yub me penyo: lwongo cen bot lapok tic mamegi ka adwogi me ngiyo tye atera. But dul man kibipong kace cwalo webhook ki yubu i Phase 2. Bots me Zuula i <link>WhatsApp ki Telegram</link> tye ka yubu gi i kom gedo marom.

access.title: Nong yoo
access.body: Lucoo lok angeya ma ki moko ki ludito tic twero cweyo lagony tin i <keys>Account → API donyo</keys>; obi cako tic ka API ocako tic i Phase 2. Pi ribbe pa ot lok angeya onyo rwom me kigeng madit, cwali email <email>hello@zuula.ug</email>. Tic ki API nyutu ni iyee <terms>API lok</terms>.

mission.title: Uganda neno wel lok ma ki cwalo ne dano mapol nino ki nino. Zuula ngiyo gi ma pud pe i nywako ne.
mission.body: Zuula (ma kiyubu ki Uganda Fact-Guard) obedo AI-kony me ngiyo lok ada ma kiyubu pi kit ma lok angeya woto kwede kany — i WhatsApp, i lok me gurup ki i kabedo me nywako lok, pol kare oyot loyo kit ma ot poko lok angeya mo keken twero moko ne. Mi lok ma iwaco ci inong tam ma jenge i kom caden, pe tam keken.

methodology.title: Kit ma wacobo kwede lok
methodology.description: Pimo acel acel lubu yoo angwen ma rom, kadi bed ni ki tiyo kwede onyo ki cwalo ne bot ngat mo me ngiyo.

submit.body: Ket coc, nywak ki yoo me kube onyo ket jami ma ineno (ma oo 50 MB). Inongo namba me lubu kor ID ki itwero lubu kwed ne kare ki kare.

check.title: Watye ka ngiyo ne
check.body: Lok ne ki ngiyo i kom lok ma genne pa dano me Uganda ki lobo mawoko, ki ngiyo pi AI-ma kiyubu ki coc, deepfakes ki audio onyo vidio ma ki yubo.

publish.title: Kikatti ki ngolo kop
publish.body: Ineno kop ma ki ngolo, caden matye i ngeye ki yoo mene ma giyee onyo pe giyee — pe obedo alama keken.

review.title: Lwak ki jo ma ngiyo lok gi miyo tam
review.body: Lukwan pimo tam ma kimoko. Ka dano mapol pe giyee, ladiro ma ki yee ni ngiyo lok ne dok twero moko onyo kwanyo woko — adwogi tic ne dong ki keto alama iye ni “Dano oyee.”

label.body: Zuula pe kwanyo coc pa ngat mo keken. Wa coyo lok ma ki ngolo ki caden kacel kwede.

rules.title: Rwom me ngiyo jami weng tye ki cik marom
rules.body: Lwak, lucoo lok angeya ki ludiro ma gi miyo tam gi konyo me nongo rwom me gen pa lwak, ma ki keto iye pek malube ki rekod me tic — pe tye ngat mo ma bolo kwir ne ki kwero labongo tyen lok.

accountable.title: Lungol tic gi tiyo ticgi
accountable.body: Ludiro ma gitye ki ngec me tic gi mito ni omyero kicoyo lok ma moko tam ne dok bene kicoyo i buk pa ludito ma twero ngiyo.

sources.title: Kama oaa iye kinyutu, pe okanne
sources.body: Ripot weng kubu caden ma ki ngiyo, pi meno itwero moko tam wa in ikomi.

whatsapp.title: Ngi lok ma aa ki bot WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Pe tye app, pe tye data bundle pi browser — cwalo kwena ki nongo adwogi ne i lok me coko tam.
whatsapp.body: A WhatsApp ki Telegram bot kiyubu pi yub me API pa platform, dong ibi bedo ki kero me cwalo kwena atir bot Zuula kit ma dong icwalo ne bot luremi. Pe tye ka tic kombedi — pi kombedi, ti ki <link>Ngiyo</link> iwi yamo.

faq.title: Lapeny ma ki penyo kare ki kare

free.q: Zuula tye agonya me tic kwede?
free.a: Ngiyo lok ki kwano Library tye me nono pi dano weng. Journalist ki Expert accounts mito accreditation, pien gin gi tingo pek madit i community score dok twero ngiyo lok ma ki keto alama iye.

submit.a: Text (calo WhatsApp ma cito anyim), kubu, coc weng, onyo jami me mako lok — cal, dwon ki vidio ma oo 50 MB.

time.q: Pimo cente tero kare ma rom mene?
time.a: Lok ma kicoyo ipol kare tero cekon 10. Media twero tero dakika acel. Lok ma ki cwalo bot ngat ma ngeyo lok me ngiyo ne lubu agiki me ngiyo ne me kakare.

verdicts.q: Adwoki me ngolo kop ni tye ki tyen lok ango?

disagree.q: Ka ce pe acwako kop ma ki ngolo?
disagree.a: Ket rwom ne. Rwom ma aa ki bot lwak, lucoo lok angeya ki ludiro ki ribo gi i Community Confidence Score. Ka adwogi me ngolo kop opoto piny tutwal ki rwom ma oromo, ki keto alama pi ladiro me ngiyo ki moko onyo kwanyo woko.

languages.a: Kwac twero ngiyo i leb munu, Luganda, Acholi, Runyankole ki Ateso. Kabedo ne bene tye ka gonyo i leb magi bene; gin mo keken ma pud pe kigonyo nen i leb munu.

data.a: I te cik me Uganda's Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019. Nen <link>Cik me mung</link> wa.

who.q: Anga ma yubu ki miyo cente me Zuula?
who.a: Zuula (“Uganda Fact-Guard”) kiyubu ki Centre for Intelligent Technologies i Victoria University Kampala macalo yub me kwan ki miti pa lwak. Ngolo kop ki nongo ne labongo jami mo keken ma miyo cente onyo lacat wil.

contact.title: Nong lok
contact.description: Lapeny ma mako lok me ngolo kop, kabedo onyo ribbe.

general.title: Lapeny mapat-pat
general.body: Lok me poko lok angeya, ribbe ki lapeny me yoo me tic.

privacy.metaDescription: Kit ma Zuula coko, tiyo ki gwoko ngec ma mako in.
privacy.title: Mung
privacy.description: Kit ma wan wayubu, watiyo ki dok wagwoko kwede lok ma mako komi.

overview.title: Neno weng
overview.body: Cik man tito ngo ma Zuula coko ka ineno lok me cul, yeny i Library onyo cako akaunt, ki kit ma ngec meno kitiyo kwede ki gwoko ite cik me Cik me gwoko ngec ki mung, 2019 me Uganda. Tiyo pi website me Zuula ki, ka dong ocako tic, WhatsApp ki Telegram bots ki partner API.

items.account: Lok matut i kom akaunt — nying, email onyo nama cim, ki tic (Lwak, Lacoo lok angeya, Ngat ma tye ki ngec onyo latic).
items.submissions: Coyo lok — coc, kubu onyo jami ma in ipenyo Zuula me ngiyo, ki lubu kor ID ma kimiyo.
items.ratings: Rwom ki adwogi tic — lok ma imoko, tam ma iweko ki jami ma iketo pi ngiyo.
items.accreditation: Waraga me miyo twero — pi Journalist ki Expert applications, jami ma imiyo me ngiyo.
items.device: Ngec ma mako kit ma kitiyo kwede — pot buk ma ki limo, kit me yeny ki kabedo ma cok, wek tic obed maber dok tiyo.

items.pipeline: Me ngiyo lok ne ki i yoo me ngeyo ne wek onyuti kit ma tye kwede ki adwogi ne.
items.ccs: Me nongo ki ribo rwom me kare pa lwak i kom dul moni ma tye ki gen.
items.accreditation: Me neno kit ma lucoo lok angeya ki ludiro gi tiyo kwede, ki me coyo tam pa ngat ma ngiyo jami i coc me ngiyo tic.
items.abuse: Me niang tic ma ki yubu onyo kiyubo me miyo rwom ki gwoko kabedo ne ki i kom balo ne.
items.accuracy: Me pimo ki yubu kit ma ngolo kop tye kakare kwede ikare me kare.

aiSharing.title: AI kwed ki dul me adek
aiSharing.body: Ngiyo lok ma ki waco twero bedo iye cwalo coc ne, onyo coc me dwon ne onyo vidio ne, bot yoo me nongo jami ma kiyubu pire kene ki, pi nongo caden, bot AI ma ki keto iye. Media ma iketo iye ki ngiyo pi malware ma peya ki tic kwede.
aiSharing.review: Pien jami mogo ma miyo kony magi twero tic ki ngec woko me Uganda, watye ka ngiyo kit ma ngec woto kwede i kom cik me gwoko ngec ki lok ma mako dano, 2019 mapud pe ki yabo woko me yubu ngec ma pe atir. But man kibiketo ngec manyen ka ngiyo ne otum.

dppa.title: Twero ni ite cik me gwoko ngec ki mung, 2019
dppa.intro: Macalo ngat ma ki tiimo kwede tic i te cik me Uganda, itye ki twero me:

items.access: Nongo ngec ma mako in ki watye kwede.
items.correct: Yubu ngec ma pe tye kakare onyo ma pe otum.
items.delete: Kwayo me kwanyo ngec ma i account ni, ma lubu cik ma mako gwoko jami piny ma tye piny kany.
items.object: Jami ma ki keto iye cwiny, onyo penyo wa me gengo, tic mogo.
items.complain: Ket koko ni ki Uganda's Personal Data Protection Office (National Information Technology Authority-Uganda) ka itamo ni watiyo marac i kom ngec ma mako in.

dppa.outro: Me tic ki twero magi, kubbe kwedwa kun itiyo ki lok matut ma tye i <contact>Lok ki penyo pi ngec</contact> piny kany.

retention.title: Wabiketo ne pi kare ma rom mene
retention.body: Adwogi me ngolo kop ma kicoyo ki caden gi tye ikin rekod me ngiyo lok ada pa lwak dok ki gwoko pi kare malac, kit ma kigwoko kwede lok angeya macon. Lok matut me account ki gwoko ka account ni tye ka tic ki pi kare manok ingee ne, me konyo ngiyo ki neno ni jami ma mite pi yub me ngiyo lok tye kakare. Kopi me pwail ma ki ngiyo pi malware ki gwoko keken ka mite me nyutu adwogi me ngolo kop.

cookies.title: Cookies ki gwoko jami ma i kabedo
cookies.body: Watimo tic ki session cookie me gwoko in ma kicoyo iye, ki local storage me poo ikom theme ni ki yero leb ma imaro i kom nyonyo man. Pe watimo tic ki third-party advertising trackers.

children.title: Kwo pa lutino
children.body: Zuula kiyubu pi jo ma tye ki mwaka 18 ki malo. Pe wa coko ngec me kom lutino, dok wabijwiko mo keken ma wanongo ni tye kwede.

changes.title: Lok ma ki loko i kom cik man
changes.body: Wabibedo ka loko nino ma tye i wi pot buk man kace cik man olokke, ki bene wabi keto aloka-loka matye i <home>pot buk me gang</home> ma pud peya gucako tic kwede.

contact.title: Lok ki penyo pi ngec
contact.body: Email <email>privacy@zuula.ug</email> pi lapeny mo keken ma mako cik man onyo me tic ki twero ni ite cik me gwoko ngec ki lok ma pe ingeyo, 2019. Nen bene <terms>Cik me tic</terms> wa.

terms.metaDescription: Nyig lok ma doro tic ki Zuula.
terms.title: Lok ma mako
terms.description: Nyig lok ma doro tic ki Zuula.

acceptance.title: Ye lok magi
acceptance.body: Ki tic ki Zuula — website, ki i anyim WhatsApp/Telegram bots ki partner API — icwako cik magi. Ka pe icwako, tim ber pe itii ki tic ne.

service.title: Zuula tye ngo (ki pe obedo)
service.body: Zuula ngiyo lok ma ki waco, kubu ki jami me poko ngec kun tiyo ki yoo me nongo lok ma ki keto iye cing, ki ka lok mo odoko tek, dano ma ki moko ni gi twero ngiyo ne. Ngolo kop nyutu kit ma wan oneno kwede caden ma tye ikare ma kicoyo ne, dok twero loke ka caden maber obino. Zuula obedo gin me ngiyo lok ada, pe obedo tam me cik, yot kom onyo lim, ki ngolo kop pe obedo gin ma leyo ka wang tam ma megi.

items.roles: Ngat mo keken twero coyo nyinge me bedo latic pa lwak. Tic pa lucoo lok angeya ki ludiro mito niang i komgi.
items.accurate: Mi ngec matir ka itye ka coyo nyingi onyo penyo pi twero me tic.
items.one: Gwok akaunt acel pi ngat acel, ki gwok ngec me donyo ni i mung — itye ki twero pi tic ma tye i te akaunt ni.
items.twoFactor: Mito ni ngat moni obed ki jami aryo ma nyutu ni en aye tye ka tic ki akaunt me Expert ki Admin.

submissions.title: Miyo lok ma itye kwede
submissions.body: Omyero ibed ki twero me nywako gin mo keken ma iketo pi ngiyo. Pe iket jami ma tye i cik, ma balo kwo pa ngat mukene, onyo ma pe itye ki twero me nywako.
submissions.publish: Kiketo pwail ma ki ngiyo pi malware ma peya ki ngiyo. Miyo gin mo ki adwogi ne Zuula oo iye twero bedo ni ki bi coyo macalo but rekod me ngiyo lok ada pa lwak, kit ma ot poko lok angeya coyo kwede ngo ma gi ngiyo lok ada iye.

ratings.title: Rwom me kwo pa lwak ki kit gi
ratings.body: Nen lok ma ki ngolo i komgi ki ada, kun jenge i kom caden ma kinyutu. Tic me ribo onyo loko rwom me tic (me lapore, gurup pa akaunt ma miyo rwom kacel me cwalo adwogi me ngolo kop) twero weko rwom gi ki kwanyo woko ki akaunt ma tye iye ki juku tic gi. Itwero miyo ripot i kom gin ma tye onyo rwom ma nen calo kiloko ne ki i pot buk me ripot.

api.title: API ki yoo me donyo pa luyub

ip.title: Jami ma kiyubu ki ryeko
ip.body: Nying Zuula, alama ki nyim tye pa Centre for Intelligent Technologies, Victoria University Kampala. Itwero bedo ki yom cwiny me nywako, mako cal ki miyo ngec i kom Zuula ma kicoyo lok ma kimoko ki keto nying ki kubu ne cen i adwogi tic.

disclaimer.title: Bedo kakare ki kama twero me culu tye iye
disclaimer.body: Waneno lok weng ma kiwaco ki gen maber dok wa coyo caden ma tye ingee ngolo kop acel acel, ento pe wa miyo cikke ni ngolo kop mo keken pe tye ki bal. Kit ma cik me Uganda yee kwede, Zuula ki Victoria University CIT pe gitye ki twero pi tam ma kimoko kun jenge i kom ngolo kop.

termination.title: Juko tic ki tyeko tic
termination.body: Watwero juko onyo loro akaunt pi nywaro tic kwede, rwom ma ki loko, onyo turu cik magi. Itwero loro akaunt mamegi ikare mo keken ki i yub me Account settings.

law.title: Cik ma doro
law.body: Cik me lobo Uganda aye doro lok magi.

changes.title: Lok ma ki loko i kom cik magi
changes.body: Watwero nwoyo lok magi ka yub ne tye ka dongo. Wabino nwoyo nino ma malo ka watimo; mede ki tic ki Zuula ingee aloka-loka nyutu ni iyee cik manyen.

contact.title: Kube
contact.body: Lapeny i kom lok magi? Cwal email bot <email>hello@zuula.ug</email>. Nen bene <privacy>Cik me mung</privacy> wa.
